================================================================================
SERVICES
================================================================================

## Construction Cleaning Services

### Overview
Professional post-construction cleanup designed to transform construction sites into pristine, inspection-ready spaces. A systematic 3-phase approach meets inspection standards and project deadlines.

### 3-Phase Process

#### Phase 1: Rough Cleaning
- Major debris removal
- Construction material disposal
- Safety hazard elimination
- Initial dust control

#### Phase 2: Detailed Cleaning
- Window cleaning (interior and exterior)
- Fixture cleaning and polishing
- Surface cleaning (all materials)
- Floor preparation
- Sticker and label removal
- Cabinet and millwork cleaning

#### Phase 3: Final Inspection
- Touch-up cleaning
- Quality assurance inspection
- Client walkthrough preparation
- Occupancy permit readiness

### Construction Projects Served
Commercial buildings, residential developments, industrial facilities, healthcare construction, educational institutions, retail and shopping centers, multi-family housing, government buildings.

## Commercial Cleaning Services

### Overview
Comprehensive commercial cleaning and janitorial services with flexible scheduling options.

### Standard Services
- Office cleaning and sanitization
- Restroom cleaning and restocking
- Break room and kitchen cleaning
- Floor care (vacuuming, mopping, buffing)
- Trash removal and recycling
- Window and glass cleaning
- Dusting and surface cleaning

### Specialized Commercial Services
- Medical and dental office cleaning
- Educational facility cleaning
- Retail store cleaning
- Restaurant and food service cleaning
- Gym and fitness center cleaning
- Property management cleaning

### Scheduling Options
Daily, nightly, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly deep cleaning, on-call, and emergency response.

### Industries Served
Corporate offices, medical and dental offices, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, government buildings, financial institutions, tech companies, manufacturing facilities, food processing plants, retail stores, restaurants, churches, car dealerships.

================================================================================
PRICING & QUOTING
================================================================================

## Pricing Factors
- Square footage of facility
- Type of cleaning (construction vs. commercial)
- Frequency of service
- Complexity of work
- Special requirements (medical, food-safe, etc.)
- Accessibility and timing constraints

## Quote Process
1. Contact via phone or website
2. Initial consultation (phone or site visit)
3. Detailed assessment
4. Written quote within 24 hours
5. No hidden fees or surprise charges

## Pricing Models
- Per square foot (construction)
- Flat rate projects
- Hourly rates for small projects
- Monthly contracts (commercial)

================================================================================
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
================================================================================

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: 16 cities across Idaho (headquartered in Idaho Falls) and 8 cities along Utah's Wasatch Front and Cache Valley (Logan, Ogden, Salt Lake City, Provo and surrounding cities).

Q: Are you insured?
A: Yes, we are fully insured and bonded in both Idaho and Utah, with general liability insurance and workers' compensation coverage.

Q: How quickly can you respond?
A: Idaho Falls and Pocatello get immediate/same-day response. Boise, Twin Falls, and Utah locations typically receive 24-72 hour response. Emergency services are available for all locations.

Q: Do you provide free quotes?
A: Yes, all estimates are free with no obligation. Most quotes are delivered within 24 hours.

Q: What is your construction cleanup process?
A: A 3-phase system: Phase 1 (rough cleaning and debris removal), Phase 2 (detailed surface and fixture cleaning), Phase 3 (final inspection and touch-up), ensuring every project is inspection-ready.

Q: Can you work around our business hours?
A: Yes. Flexible scheduling includes nights, weekends, and holidays.

Q: Do you have experience with specialized facilities?
A: Yes, we have experience with healthcare, food processing, educational, government, and industrial facilities and their compliance requirements.
